q: 奶奶没学过用手机，所以不___用。
zh: 奶奶没学过用手机，所以不会用。
py: nǎi nǎi méi xué guò yòng shǒu jī suǒ yǐ bù huì yòng
en: Grandma has never learned to use a phone, so she can't use one.
why: 没学过 gives the reason as never having learned, so the negative of know-how is 不会. 不可以 would say she is forbidden to use it, which the reason does not support.

q: 冬天我们去滑冰，可是我没学过，不___滑。
zh: 冬天我们去滑冰，可是我没学过，不会滑。
py: dōng tiān wǒ men qù huá bīng kě shì wǒ méi xué guò bù huì huá
en: We go skating in winter, but I have never learned, so I can't skate.
why: 没学过 shows the skill is missing, so 不会. 不可以滑 would mean skating is not allowed, which has nothing to do with never having learned.

q: 弟弟从小在海边长大，很小就___游泳。
zh: 弟弟从小在海边长大，很小就会游泳。
py: dì di cóng xiǎo zài hǎi biān zhǎng dà hěn xiǎo jiù huì yóu yǒng
en: My younger brother grew up by the sea and could swim from a very young age.
why: 从小 and 很小就 point to a skill learned early, which is 会. 可以 would say he was permitted or had the option to swim, not that he knew how.

q: 我没学过法语，一句也不___说。
zh: 我没学过法语，一句也不会说。
py: wǒ méi xué guò fǎ yǔ yī jù yě bù huì shuō
en: I have never studied French; I can't say a single sentence.
why: 没学过 says the skill was never learned, so 不会. 不可以 would say that speaking French is forbidden, which the reason does not support.

q: 她学过按摩，所以___按肩膀，按得很舒服。
zh: 她学过按摩，所以会按肩膀，按得很舒服。
py: tā xué guò àn mó suǒ yǐ huì àn jiān bǎng àn de hěn shū fu
en: She has studied massage, so she knows how to massage shoulders, and it feels very comfortable.
why: 学过 marks a learned skill, so 会. 可以 would offer an option or permission and ignore the fact that her ability comes from training.

q: 明天___下雪，你多穿一件衣服。
zh: 明天会下雪，你多穿一件衣服。
py: míng tiān huì xià xuě nǐ duō chuān yī jiàn yī fu
en: It will snow tomorrow, so put on an extra layer.
why: 明天 plus a weather event is a prediction, so 会. 可以下雪 would give snow permission, which makes no sense.

q: 天气预报说，周末___下大雨。
zh: 天气预报说，周末会下大雨。
py: tiān qì yù bào shuō zhōu mò huì xià dà yǔ
en: The forecast says it will pour this weekend.
why: A forecast reports what will happen, which is 会. 可以 means allowed or an open option, and rain is neither.

q: 夏天太热了，不戴帽子，你___头疼。
zh: 夏天太热了，不戴帽子，你会头疼。
py: xià tiān tài rè le bù dài mào zi nǐ huì tóu téng
en: It is so hot in summer; without a hat you will get a headache.
why: The first clause is the cause and the second its likely result, a prediction, so 会. 可以头疼 would grant permission to have a headache.

q: 别怕，打针一点儿也不___疼。
zh: 别怕，打针一点儿也不会疼。
py: bié pà dǎ zhēn yī diǎn r yě bù huì téng
en: Don't be scared; the injection won't hurt at all.
why: Reassuring someone about what will happen takes 会 / 不会. 不能疼 would mean it is not possible or not allowed for it to hurt, as if pain were a rule.

q: 如果你每天睡得太少，身体就___生病。
zh: 如果你每天睡得太少，身体就会生病。
py: rú guǒ nǐ měi tiān shuì de tài shǎo shēn tǐ jiù huì shēng bìng
en: If you sleep too little every day, you will get sick.
why: 如果 sets a condition and the second clause is its predicted result, so 会. 可以 would make getting sick something permitted.

q: 春天一到，天气就___慢慢变暖。
zh: 春天一到，天气就会慢慢变暖。
py: chūn tiān yī dào tiān qì jiù huì màn màn biàn nuǎn
en: Once spring arrives, the weather will gradually warm up.
why: Saying what the weather will do as the season turns is a prediction, so 会. 可以 cannot predict.

q: 医生说，只要你按时吃药，过几天感冒就___好。
zh: 医生说，只要你按时吃药，过几天感冒就会好。
py: yī shēng shuō zhǐ yào nǐ àn shí chī yào guò jǐ tiān gǎn mào jiù huì hǎo
en: The doctor says that if you take your medicine on time, the cold will clear up in a few days.
why: 只要...就 gives a condition and a predicted outcome, so 会好. 可以好 would turn getting better into something permitted.

q: 你放心，这个药吃了不___想睡觉。
zh: 你放心，这个药吃了不会想睡觉。
py: nǐ fàng xīn zhè ge yào chī le bù huì xiǎng shuì jiào
en: Don't worry; this medicine won't make you sleepy.
why: Telling someone what will not happen is 不会. 不可以想睡觉 would say that feeling sleepy is forbidden.

q: 你放心，我不___忘记吃药的。
zh: 你放心，我不会忘记吃药的。
py: nǐ fàng xīn wǒ bù huì wàng jì chī yào de
en: Don't worry, I won't forget to take my medicine.
why: 放心 plus the closing 的 is the reassurance pattern 会 ... 的. 不能忘记 would say 'I must not forget', a rule rather than a promise.

q: 别担心，明天天气一定___好的。
zh: 别担心，明天天气一定会好的。
py: bié dān xīn míng tiān tiān qì yī dìng huì hǎo de
en: Don't worry, the weather will definitely be fine tomorrow.
why: 一定 ... 的 reassures about what will happen, which is 会. 可以 would suggest the weather is allowed to be good.

q: 别担心，我一定会按时回家___。
zh: 别担心，我一定会按时回家的。
py: bié dān xīn wǒ yī dìng huì àn shí huí jiā de
en: Don't worry, I will definitely be home on time.
why: A promise about the future is closed with 的 after 会. 了 reports a completed event or a change, which clashes with a promise, and 着 does not fit at all.

q: 你放心，我绝对不___把你的病告诉别人的。
zh: 你放心，我绝对不会把你的病告诉别人的。
py: nǐ fàng xīn wǒ jué duì bù huì bǎ nǐ de bìng gào sù bié rén de
en: Don't worry, I will absolutely not tell anyone about your illness.
why: A reassuring promise with a final 的 takes 会. 不可以 would say that someone forbids me from telling, not that I promise not to.

q: 医生说你不用担心，这个手术不___有危险的。
zh: 医生说你不用担心，这个手术不会有危险的。
py: yī shēng shuō nǐ bù yòng dān xīn zhè ge shǒu shù bù huì yǒu wēi xiǎn de
en: The doctor says not to worry; this operation will not be dangerous.
why: A doctor's reassurance about what will not happen is 不会 ... 的. 不能有危险 would mean it is impossible or forbidden for there to be danger.

q: 别难过，雨停以后，太阳一定___出来的。
zh: 别难过，雨停以后，太阳一定会出来的。
py: bié nán guò yǔ tíng yǐ hòu tài yáng yī dìng huì chū lái de
en: Don't be sad; after the rain stops, the sun will definitely come out.
why: A confident prediction ending in 的 uses 会. 可以 would suggest the sun is permitted to come out.

q: 别急，你的感冒过几天就___好___。
zh: 别急，你的感冒过几天就会好的。
py: bié jí nǐ de gǎn mào guò jǐ tiān jiù huì hǎo de
en: Don't worry, your cold will be better in a few days.
why: In 会 ... 的 the 的 closes the whole sentence after the verb. Putting 的 right after 会 breaks the pattern and gives 就会的好, which is not Chinese.

q: 只要你多休息，身体一定会好起来___。
zh: 只要你多休息，身体一定会好起来的。
py: zhǐ yào nǐ duō xiū xi shēn tǐ yī dìng huì hǎo qǐ lái de
en: As long as you rest more, you will certainly get better.
why: A reassuring 一定会 ... ends in 的. 了 would report a change that has already happened, which a forward-looking 只要 sentence does not.

q: 我会游泳，但是今天发烧了，不___下水。
zh: 我会游泳，但是今天发烧了，不能下水。
py: wǒ huì yóu yǒng dàn shì jīn tiān fā shāo le bù néng xià shuǐ
en: I can swim, but I have a fever today, so I can't get in the water.
why: 我会游泳 says the skill exists; today's fever is a circumstance that blocks it, so 不能. 不会 would contradict 我会游泳.

q: 我会开车，可是我吃了感冒药，现在不___开车。
zh: 我会开车，可是我吃了感冒药，现在不能开车。
py: wǒ huì kāi chē kě shì wǒ chī le gǎn mào yào xiàn zài bù néng kāi chē
en: I can drive, but I have taken cold medicine, so I can't drive right now.
why: The skill is there, but the medicine is a circumstance that rules driving out now, so 不能. 不会开车 would claim I never learned, against 我会开车.

q: 他会弹钢琴，可是手受伤了，这个月不___弹。
zh: 他会弹钢琴，可是手受伤了，这个月不能弹。
py: tā huì tán gāng qín kě shì shǒu shòu shāng le zhè ge yuè bù néng tán
en: He can play the piano, but his hand is injured, so he can't play this month.
why: An injured hand is a circumstance that blocks a skill he already has, so 不能. 不会弹 contradicts 他会弹钢琴.

q: 奶奶的腿好了，现在___自己下楼了。
zh: 奶奶的腿好了，现在能自己下楼了。
py: nǎi nǎi de tuǐ hǎo le xiàn zài néng zì jǐ xià lóu le
en: Grandma's leg has healed, and now she can go downstairs by herself again.
why: Getting an ability back after a leg recovers is 能. 会 would suggest she has just learned how to go down stairs, as a toddler does.

q: 手机没电了，我现在不___给你拍照。
zh: 手机没电了，我现在不能给你拍照。
py: shǒu jī méi diàn le wǒ xiàn zài bù néng gěi nǐ pāi zhào
en: My phone is out of battery, so I can't take your photo now.
why: A dead battery makes it physically impossible, so 不能. 不可以 would mean that someone forbids the photo.

q: 雨停了，路也干了，我们现在___出发了。
zh: 雨停了，路也干了，我们现在能出发了。
py: yǔ tíng le lù yě gān le wǒ men xiàn zài néng chū fā le
en: The rain has stopped and the road is dry, so we can set off now.
why: The obstacle has gone, so it is now possible to leave: 能 ... 了. 会出发了 would predict that we will leave, not say that leaving has become possible.

q: 你的肚子还在疼，现在不___喝冰水。
zh: 你的肚子还在疼，现在不能喝冰水。
py: nǐ de dù zi hái zài téng xiàn zài bù néng hē bīng shuǐ
en: Your stomach still hurts, so you can't drink ice water now.
why: The body's condition decides what is possible or advisable now, so 不能. 不会 would predict that you will not drink it, which is not what is being said.

q: 台风来了，所有的航班都取消了，今天谁也不___坐飞机去上海。
zh: 台风来了，所有的航班都取消了，今天谁也不能坐飞机去上海。
py: tái fēng lái le suǒ yǒu de háng bān dōu qǔ xiāo le jīn tiān shéi yě bù néng zuò fēi jī qù shàng hǎi
en: A typhoon has arrived and every flight is cancelled, so nobody can fly to Shanghai today.
why: Cancelled flights make it impossible, so 不能. 不可以 would imply a rule forbidding people to fly, not a circumstance that blocks it.

q: 我的手好了，现在___拿东西了。
zh: 我的手好了，现在能拿东西了。
py: wǒ de shǒu hǎo le xiàn zài néng ná dōng xi le
en: My hand has healed, so I can carry things again now.
why: Recovery gives back an ability you had, which is 能 ... 了. 会拿东西了 would say you have just learned to hold things, like a baby.

q: 河里的冰太薄了，现在不___在上面走。
zh: 河里的冰太薄了，现在不能在上面走。
py: hé lǐ de bīng tài báo le xiàn zài bù néng zài shàng miàn zǒu
en: The ice on the river is too thin; you can't walk on it now.
why: Thin ice is a physical circumstance that stops walking, so 不能. 不会 would not describe a ban or impossibility.

q: 牙不疼了，现在什么都___吃了。
zh: 牙不疼了，现在什么都能吃了。
py: yá bù téng le xiàn zài shén me dōu néng chī le
en: My tooth no longer hurts; now I can eat anything.
why: Once the pain is gone, eating becomes possible again, so 能. 会吃 would suggest learning how to eat.

q: 他一口气___吃五个包子，真厉害。
zh: 他一口气能吃五个包子，真厉害。
py: tā yī kǒu qì néng chī wǔ gè bāo zi zhēn lì hai
en: He can eat five steamed buns in one go; that is impressive.
why: Five buns in one go is an amount reached, which takes 能. 会 would only predict that he will eat them and says nothing about capacity.

q: 我现在一次___游五十米。
zh: 我现在一次能游五十米。
py: wǒ xiàn zài yī cì néng yóu wǔ shí mǐ
en: I can swim fifty metres at a time now.
why: A distance measured after the verb is ability by amount, so 能. 会 would say only that I know how to swim.

q: 她跑得很快，一分钟___跑三百米。
zh: 她跑得很快，一分钟能跑三百米。
py: tā pǎo de hěn kuài yī fēn zhōng néng pǎo sān bǎi mǐ
en: She runs fast; she can run three hundred metres in a minute.
why: Speed over a time span, here 三百米 in 一分钟, is measured ability, so 能. 会 would make it a prediction.

q: 他的力气很大，一只手就___拿二十公斤的米。
zh: 他的力气很大，一只手就能拿二十公斤的米。
py: tā de lì qi hěn dà yī zhī shǒu jiù néng ná èr shí gōng jīn de mǐ
en: He is very strong; he can lift twenty kilos of rice with one hand.
why: 二十公斤 is the amount his strength can handle, so 能. 会 would not describe capacity.

q: 这辆自行车很快，一个小时___骑二十公里。
zh: 这辆自行车很快，一个小时能骑二十公里。
py: zhè liàng zì xíng chē hěn kuài yī gè xiǎo shí néng qí èr shí gōng lǐ
en: This bike is fast; you can ride twenty kilometres in an hour.
why: Distance covered in a set time measures capacity, so 能. 会 would only predict.

q: 爸爸的身体很好，现在一口气___爬二十层楼。
zh: 爸爸的身体很好，现在一口气能爬二十层楼。
py: bà ba de shēn tǐ hěn hǎo xiàn zài yī kǒu qì néng pá èr shí céng lóu
en: Dad is in good health; he can now climb twenty floors in one go.
why: 二十层 is the amount his body can manage, so 能. 会爬 would say he knows how to climb or will climb.

q: 腿很疼，我现在连五分钟都不___站。
zh: 腿很疼，我现在连五分钟都不能站。
py: tuǐ hěn téng wǒ xiàn zài lián wǔ fēn zhōng dōu bù néng zhàn
en: My leg hurts so much that I can't even stand for five minutes now.
why: The duration 五分钟 and the pain make this a limit on capacity, so 不能. 不会站 would say that I never learned how to stand.

q: 冬天白天很短，下午五点天就黑了，我们最多只___玩两个小时。
zh: 冬天白天很短，下午五点天就黑了，我们最多只能玩两个小时。
py: dōng tiān bái tiān hěn duǎn xià wǔ wǔ diǎn tiān jiù hēi le wǒ men zuì duō zhǐ néng wán liǎng gè xiǎo shí
en: Winter days are short and it is dark by five, so we can play for two hours at most.
why: 最多只 and 两个小时 set an upper limit on what the situation allows, which is 能. 会 would predict, not set a limit.

q: 这个杯子很小，只___装一杯水。
zh: 这个杯子很小，只能装一杯水。
py: zhè ge bēi zi hěn xiǎo zhǐ néng zhuāng yī bēi shuǐ
en: This cup is small; it can only hold one cup of water.
why: How much a container holds is a measured capacity, so 能. 会 would predict what it will do.

q: 我头疼得厉害，晚上每次只___睡两个小时。
zh: 我头疼得厉害，晚上每次只能睡两个小时。
py: wǒ tóu téng de lì hai wǎn shang měi cì zhǐ néng shuì liǎng gè xiǎo shí
en: My headache is terrible; I can only sleep two hours at a time at night.
why: The headache limits how long I can sleep, and 两个小时 is that limit, so 只能. 会 would not express a limit.

q: 这儿___吃东西吗？
zh: 这儿可以吃东西吗？
py: zhè r kě yǐ chī dōng xi ma
en: Is it all right to eat here?
why: Asking whether something is allowed takes 可以. 会吃东西吗 would ask whether you will eat or know how to eat.

q: 医生，我今天___洗澡吗？
zh: 医生，我今天可以洗澡吗？
py: yī shēng wǒ jīn tiān kě yǐ xǐ zǎo ma
en: Doctor, may I take a bath today?
why: Asking a doctor for permission is 可以 ... 吗. 会洗澡吗 would ask whether I will bathe.

q: 太冷了，你___穿我的外套。
zh: 太冷了，你可以穿我的外套。
py: tài lěng le nǐ kě yǐ chuān wǒ de wài tào
en: It's too cold; you can wear my coat.
why: Offering an option is 可以. 会 would predict that you will wear it, which is not an offer.

q: 雨下得太大了，你们___在我家住一晚。
zh: 雨下得太大了，你们可以在我家住一晚。
py: yǔ xià de tài dà le nǐ men kě yǐ zài wǒ jiā zhù yī wǎn
en: It is raining too hard; you can stay the night at my place.
why: Offering an option to the guests takes 可以. 会 would predict that they will stay, not offer it.

q: 考试的时候，___带笔，但是不能带手机。
zh: 考试的时候，可以带笔，但是不能带手机。
py: kǎo shì de shí hou kě yǐ dài bǐ dàn shì bù néng dài shǒu jī
en: During the exam you may bring a pen, but not a phone.
why: A rule about what is allowed is 可以; 但是不能 marks the contrast with what is forbidden. 会带笔 would predict that you will bring one.

q: 要是你觉得身体不舒服，___先回家休息，我替你上课。
zh: 要是你觉得身体不舒服，可以先回家休息，我替你上课。
py: yào shi nǐ jué de shēn tǐ bù shū fu kě yǐ xiān huí jiā xiū xi wǒ tì nǐ shàng kè
en: If you feel unwell, you can go home and rest first; I'll cover your class.
why: The second clause is an offer of an option, so 可以. 会先回家 would predict that you will go home, which does not fit an offer to cover for you.

q: 我明天要去看病，不___来上课了。
zh: 我明天要去看病，不能来上课了。
py: wǒ míng tiān yào qù kàn bìng bù néng lái shàng kè le
en: I'm going to the doctor tomorrow, so I can't come to class.
why: 'Can't make it' because of an appointment is 不能. 不可以 would say that someone forbids me to come.

q: 雪太大了，飞机今天不___起飞。
zh: 雪太大了，飞机今天不能起飞。
py: xuě tài dà le fēi jī jīn tiān bù néng qǐ fēi
en: The snow is too heavy, so planes can't take off today.
why: Impossibility caused by weather is 不能. 不可以 would suggest a rule forbidding take-off.

q: 图书馆里不___大声说话，别人在看书。
zh: 图书馆里不能大声说话，别人在看书。
py: tú shū guǎn lǐ bù néng dà shēng shuō huà bié rén zài kàn shū
en: You can't talk loudly in the library; others are reading.
why: A prohibition is 不能. 不会 would predict that you will not talk loudly and is never a ban.

q: 你放心，他不___生气，他很爱笑。
zh: 你放心，他不会生气，他很爱笑。
py: nǐ fàng xīn tā bù huì shēng qì tā hěn ài xiào
en: Don't worry, he won't be angry; he laughs easily.
why: Saying he will not get angry is a prediction, so 不会. 不能生气 would say he is not able or not permitted to be angry.

q: 天这么蓝，今天不___下雨。
zh: 天这么蓝，今天不会下雨。
py: tiān zhè me lán jīn tiān bù huì xià yǔ
en: The sky is so blue; it won't rain today.
why: A forecast that something will not happen is 不会. 不能下雨 would mean that rain is not allowed.

q: 小王：我可以坐这儿吗？小李：不___，这儿有人了。
zh: 小王：我可以坐这儿吗？小李：不行，这儿有人了。
py: xiǎo wáng wǒ kě yǐ zuò zhè r ma xiǎo lǐ bù xíng zhè r yǒu rén le
en: Xiao Wang: May I sit here? Xiao Li: No, someone is already sitting here.
why: The natural refusal to 可以 ... 吗 is 不行 (or 不能) with a reason. 不会 is never an answer to a request for permission.

q: 他刚到中国，还不___用筷子，吃饭很慢。
zh: 他刚到中国，还不会用筷子，吃饭很慢。
py: tā gāng dào zhōng guó hái bù huì yòng kuài zi chī fàn hěn màn
en: He has just arrived in China and can't use chopsticks yet, so he eats slowly.
why: Eating slowly shows he has not learned how, so 不会. 还不可以 would say he is not yet allowed to use them.

q: 放心，这点雪不___影响明天的比赛。
zh: 放心，这点雪不会影响明天的比赛。
py: fàng xīn zhè diǎn xuě bù huì yǐng xiǎng míng tiān de bǐ sài
en: Don't worry, this little snow won't affect tomorrow's game.
why: Saying something will not happen is 不会. 不能影响 would say that it is not allowed or not able to have an effect.

q: 她唱歌很好听，只是今天感冒了，不___唱。
zh: 她唱歌很好听，只是今天感冒了，不能唱。
py: tā chàng gē hěn hǎo tīng zhǐ shì jīn tiān gǎn mào le bù néng chàng
en: She sings beautifully; she just has a cold today and can't sing.
why: The skill is clearly there, and today's cold blocks it, so 不能. 不会唱 would say she never learned, against 唱歌很好听.

q: 我妈妈很___做饭，做的菜都很好吃。
zh: 我妈妈很会做饭，做的菜都很好吃。
py: wǒ mā ma hěn huì zuò fàn zuò de cài dōu hěn hǎo chī
en: My mum is really good at cooking; everything she makes tastes good.
why: 很会 plus a verb means skilful. 可以 does not combine with 很 to describe skill.

q: 我哥哥很___吃，一顿吃四碗饭。
zh: 我哥哥很能吃，一顿吃四碗饭。
py: wǒ gē ge hěn néng chī yī dùn chī sì wǎn fàn
en: My older brother can really eat; he has four bowls of rice at a meal.
why: 四碗饭 shows a large amount, which is 很能吃. 很会吃 would praise knowing what is good to eat.

q: 护士很___照顾病人，病人都喜欢她。
zh: 护士很会照顾病人，病人都喜欢她。
py: hù shi hěn huì zhào gu bìng rén bìng rén dōu xǐ huan tā
en: The nurse is very good at looking after patients; they all like her.
why: Being liked for how she cares points to skill, so 很会. 很能照顾 would say she can take care of a lot of people.

q: 这个孩子真___睡，一天睡十六个小时。
zh: 这个孩子真能睡，一天睡十六个小时。
py: zhè ge hái zi zhēn néng shuì yī tiān shuì shí liù gè xiǎo shí
en: This kid can really sleep: sixteen hours a day.
why: 真能睡 describes a big capacity, here sixteen hours. 可以 cannot follow 真 in this way.

q: 小李真___说，开会时他一个人说了一个小时，别人都没机会说话。
zh: 小李真能说，开会时他一个人说了一个小时，别人都没机会说话。
py: xiǎo lǐ zhēn néng shuō kāi huì shí tā yī gè rén shuō le yī gè xiǎo shí bié rén dōu méi jī huì shuō huà
en: Xiao Li can really talk; at the meeting he talked alone for an hour and nobody else got a word in.
why: An hour of talking with no chance for others is quantity, so 真能说. 真会说 would praise clever speech, not the amount.

q: 我女儿特别___画画，老师说她画得很好。
zh: 我女儿特别会画画，老师说她画得很好。
py: wǒ nǚ ér tè bié huì huà huà lǎo shī shuō tā huà de hěn hǎo
en: My daughter is especially good at drawing; the teacher says she draws very well.
why: The teacher praises how well she draws, so skill: 特别会. 特别能画 would say she draws a great deal.

q: 弟弟特别___吃辣，一大碗辣面也吃得完。
zh: 弟弟特别能吃辣，一大碗辣面也吃得完。
py: dì di tè bié néng chī là yī dà wǎn là miàn yě chī de wán
en: My younger brother can really handle spicy food; he can finish a big bowl of spicy noodles.
why: How much spice and food he can handle is capacity, so 特别能吃辣. 可以 cannot sit after 特别 in this way.

q: 她很___安慰人，我难过的时候，她总是知道说什么。
zh: 她很会安慰人，我难过的时候，她总是知道说什么。
py: tā hěn huì ān wèi rén wǒ nán guò de shí hou tā zǒng shì zhī dào shuō shén me
en: She is very good at comforting people; when I'm sad, she always knows what to say.
why: Knowing what to say is a skill, so 很会. 很可以安慰人 is not Chinese, because 可以 does not take 很 to describe skill.

zh: 我一定会来的。
py: wǒ yī dìng huì lái de
en: I will definitely come.
why: The assurance pattern is 会 before the verb and 的 closing the sentence. 的 right after 会 or a 了 in its place breaks it.

zh: 北京明天会下大雪。
py: běi jīng míng tiān huì xià dà xuě
en: It will snow heavily in Beijing tomorrow.
why: A prediction puts 会 directly before the verb phrase 下大雪; the time word and place both stay before 会.

zh: 他一小时能跑十公里。
py: tā yī xiǎo shí néng pǎo shí gōng lǐ
en: He can run ten kilometres in an hour.
why: Capacity measured by distance and time takes 能 right before the verb, with the amount after it.

zh: 我明天不能去上班。
py: wǒ míng tiān bù néng qù shàng bān
en: I can't go to work tomorrow.
why: 不能 sits right before the verb for being unable to make it; the time word comes before it.

zh: 妹妹很会照顾病人。
py: mèi mei hěn huì zhào gu bìng rén
en: My younger sister is very good at looking after patients.
why: 很 comes before 会, and the verb phrase follows: 很会 + verb means skilful.

zh: 我可以坐这儿吗？
py: wǒ kě yǐ zuò zhè r ma
en: May I sit here?
why: Asking permission is 可以 before the verb and 吗 at the end. 这儿 may be fronted as the topic.

zh: 他感冒了所以今天不能去学校。
py: tā gǎn mào le suǒ yǐ jīn tiān bù néng qù xué xiào
en: He has a cold, so he can't go to school today.
why: The cold is the circumstance, so 不能 stays right before the verb phrase 去学校; the time word goes before 不能.

zh: 天气很快就会好的。
py: tiān qì hěn kuài jiù huì hǎo de
en: The weather will be fine again soon.
why: 会 ... 的 wraps the verb phrase: 就会 before 好 and the closing 的 at the very end.

zh: 如果你不吃药会更难受。
py: rú guǒ nǐ bù chī yào huì gèng nán shòu
en: If you don't take the medicine, you will feel worse.
why: 如果 sets up a condition and 会 predicts its result, so 会 comes right before 更难受 at the end.

zh: 小王一分钟能打八十个字。
py: xiǎo wáng yī fēn zhōng néng dǎ bā shí gè zì
en: Xiao Wang can type eighty characters a minute.
why: Speed measured by an amount takes 能 before the verb, with the number and measure after it.

src_py: yī yuàn lǐ kě yǐ dǎ diàn huà
task: Say it is not allowed, using 不能.
zh: 医院里不能打电话。
py: yī yuàn lǐ bù néng dǎ diàn huà
en: You can't make phone calls in the hospital.
why: Replacing 可以 with 不能 turns permission into a prohibition; 不能 stays right before the verb.

task: Reassure the listener: add 一定 and 的.
zh: 雪一定会停的。
py: xuě yī dìng huì tíng de
en: The snow will definitely stop.
why: The assurance pattern puts 一定 before 会 and 的 at the very end of the sentence.

src_py: wǒ mèi mei huì chàng gē
task: Say she is really good at it.
zh: 我妹妹很会唱歌。
py: wǒ mèi mei hěn huì chàng gē
en: My younger sister is really good at singing.
why: 很 goes before 会 to mean skilful; the verb phrase stays after it.

src_py: nǐ de tuǐ hǎo le néng zǒu lù
task: Turn it into a yes/no question with 吗.
zh: 你的腿好了，能走路吗？
py: nǐ de tuǐ hǎo le néng zǒu lù ma
en: Your leg is better; can you walk?
why: The recovered ability stays 能; 吗 is added at the end to make the yes/no question.

src_py: dì di yī dùn chī shí gè jiǎo zi
task: Say he is able to do it, using 能.
zh: 弟弟一顿能吃十个饺子。
py: dì di yī dùn néng chī shí gè jiǎo zi
en: My younger brother can eat ten dumplings in one meal.
why: An amount reached in a set time takes 能 before the verb, and the number and measure follow the verb.

s: 明天可以下雨，你带伞吧。
s_py: míng tiān kě yǐ xià yǔ nǐ dài sǎn ba
zh: 明天会下雨，你带伞吧。
py: míng tiān huì xià yǔ nǐ dài sǎn ba
en: It will rain tomorrow, so take an umbrella.
why: A weather prediction needs 会. 可以 means allowed or an open option, which makes no sense for rain.

s: 冬天快到了，天气会越来越冷。
s_py: dōng tiān kuài dào le tiān qì huì yuè lái yuè lěng
zh: 冬天快到了，天气会越来越冷。
py: dōng tiān kuài dào le tiān qì huì yuè lái yuè lěng
en: Winter is coming and it will get colder and colder.
why: 会 predicts a coming change in the weather. 能 or 可以 would not fit a forecast, so this is correct.

s: 我会开一下窗户吗？天气太热了。
s_py: wǒ huì kāi yī xià chuāng hu ma tiān qì tài rè le
zh: 我可以开一下窗户吗？天气太热了。
py: wǒ kě yǐ kāi yī xià chuāng hu ma tiān qì tài rè le
en: May I open the window? It is too hot.
why: Asking permission takes 可以. 会 would ask whether I will open it or know how to.

s: 病人现在可以喝一点儿水，不过不能喝太多。
s_py: bìng rén xiàn zài kě yǐ hē yī diǎn r shuǐ bù guò bù néng hē tài duō
zh: 病人现在可以喝一点儿水，不过不能喝太多。
py: bìng rén xiàn zài kě yǐ hē yī diǎn r shuǐ bù guò bù néng hē tài duō
en: The patient may drink a little water now, but not too much.
why: 可以 allows a small amount and 不能 sets the limit on more. Both fit permission, so the sentence is correct.

s: 别担心，医生会的帮你。
s_py: bié dān xīn yī shēng huì de bāng nǐ
zh: 别担心，医生会帮你的。
py: bié dān xīn yī shēng huì bāng nǐ de
en: Don't worry, the doctor will help you.
why: In 会 ... 的 the 的 closes the whole sentence. Putting it right after 会 breaks the pattern.

s: 我保证，今天晚上一定会把药吃完的。
s_py: wǒ bǎo zhèng jīn tiān wǎn shang yī dìng huì bǎ yào chī wán de
zh: 我保证，今天晚上一定会把药吃完的。
py: wǒ bǎo zhèng jīn tiān wǎn shang yī dìng huì bǎ yào chī wán de
en: I promise I will definitely finish the medicine tonight.
why: 会 comes before the 把 phrase and 的 closes the sentence with no 了. This looks odd with 把 but is the normal assurance pattern.

s: 你放心，我明天一定会来了的。
s_py: nǐ fàng xīn wǒ míng tiān yī dìng huì lái le de
zh: 你放心，我明天一定会来的。
py: nǐ fàng xīn wǒ míng tiān yī dìng huì lái de
en: Don't worry, I will definitely come tomorrow.
why: A promise about tomorrow cannot take 了; the pattern is 会 ... 的 with nothing added before 的.

s: 他会说中文，可是今天头很疼，不能说太多话。
s_py: tā huì shuō zhōng wén kě shì jīn tiān tóu hěn téng bù néng shuō tài duō huà
zh: 他会说中文，可是今天头很疼，不能说太多话。
py: tā huì shuō zhōng wén kě shì jīn tiān tóu hěn téng bù néng shuō tài duō huà
en: He can speak Chinese, but he has a bad headache today and can't talk too much.
why: 会 gives the skill and 不能 gives today's circumstance. Using both in one sentence is correct.

s: 我姐姐很可以游泳，游得很快。
s_py: wǒ jiě jie hěn kě yǐ yóu yǒng yóu de hěn kuài
zh: 我姐姐很会游泳，游得很快。
py: wǒ jiě jie hěn huì yóu yǒng yóu de hěn kuài
en: My older sister is very good at swimming; she swims fast.
why: 很 is followed by 会 for skill. 可以 does not take 很 in this way.

s: 对不起，我今天头疼，不可以去开会。
s_py: duì bu qǐ wǒ jīn tiān tóu téng bù kě yǐ qù kāi huì
zh: 对不起，我今天头疼，不能去开会。
py: duì bu qǐ wǒ jīn tiān tóu téng bù néng qù kāi huì
en: Sorry, I have a headache today and can't go to the meeting.
why: Being unable to attend because of a headache is 不能. 不可以 would mean that someone forbids you to go.

s: 这儿不能停车，那边可以。
s_py: zhè r bù néng tíng chē nà biān kě yǐ
zh: 这儿不能停车，那边可以。
py: zhè r bù néng tíng chē nà biān kě yǐ
en: You can't park here, but you can over there.
why: 不能 is a prohibition here and 可以 on its own means allowed there. The clipped answer is correct.

s: 我可以进去看看吗？不会，里面在检查。
s_py: wǒ kě yǐ jìn qù kàn kan ma bù huì lǐ miàn zài jiǎn chá
zh: 我可以进去看看吗？不行，里面在检查。
py: wǒ kě yǐ jìn qù kàn kan ma bù xíng lǐ miàn zài jiǎn chá
en: May I go in and look? No, they are doing an examination in there.
why: The answer to a request for permission is 不行 or 不能. 不会 would only say it will not happen.

s: 孩子会走路了，可是刚生病，今天不能出去玩。
s_py: hái zi huì zǒu lù le kě shì gāng shēng bìng jīn tiān bù néng chū qù wán
zh: 孩子会走路了，可是刚生病，今天不能出去玩。
py: hái zi huì zǒu lù le kě shì gāng shēng bìng jīn tiān bù néng chū qù wán
en: The child has learned to walk, but has just been ill and can't go out to play today.
why: 会走路了 marks a newly learned skill, and 不能 marks today's circumstance. The two modals do different jobs, so it is correct.

s: 这个箱子很小，最多能装十本书。
s_py: zhè ge xiāng zi hěn xiǎo zuì duō néng zhuāng shí běn shū
zh: 这个箱子很小，最多能装十本书。
py: zhè ge xiāng zi hěn xiǎo zuì duō néng zhuāng shí běn shū
en: This box is small; it holds ten books at most.
why: 最多 with an amount sets a capacity limit, which takes 能. 会 or 可以 would not express it.

s: 爷爷没学过英语，所以不可以说英语。
s_py: yé ye méi xué guò yīng yǔ suǒ yǐ bù kě yǐ shuō yīng yǔ
zh: 爷爷没学过英语，所以不会说英语。
py: yé ye méi xué guò yīng yǔ suǒ yǐ bú huì shuō yīng yǔ
en: Grandpa never learned English, so he can't speak it.
why: Never having learned is 不会. 不可以 would make speaking English forbidden.

s: 我哥哥不会做饭，但是很会吃。
s_py: wǒ gē ge bú huì zuò fàn dàn shì hěn huì chī
zh: 我哥哥不会做饭，但是很会吃。
py: wǒ gē ge bú huì zuò fàn dàn shì hěn huì chī
en: My older brother can't cook, but he knows good food.
why: 不会做饭 says he never learned, and 很会吃 means he knows how to enjoy food. Both are correct and they do not clash.

s: 我爸爸很能走，一天能走二十公里。
s_py: wǒ bà ba hěn néng zǒu yī tiān néng zǒu èr shí gōng lǐ
zh: 我爸爸很能走，一天能走二十公里。
py: wǒ bà ba hěn néng zǒu yī tiān néng zǒu èr shí gōng lǐ
en: My dad can really walk; he can cover twenty kilometres a day.
why: 很能 + verb means large capacity, and 二十公里 is the amount, so 能 is right in both places.

s: 别怕，这个药不会很苦。
s_py: bié pà zhè ge yào bù huì hěn kǔ
zh: 别怕，这个药不会很苦。
py: bié pà zhè ge yào bù huì hěn kǔ
en: Don't be afraid; this medicine won't be very bitter.
why: Predicting what will not happen is 不会. This is not about skill or permission, so the sentence is correct.

s: 再不吃药，你的病可以更重。
s_py: zài bù chī yào nǐ de bìng kě yǐ gèng zhòng
zh: 再不吃药，你的病会更重。
py: zài bù chī yào nǐ de bìng huì gèng zhòng
en: If you still don't take the medicine, your illness will get worse.
why: A warning about a likely result takes 会. 可以 would say that getting worse is permitted.

s: 放心吧，明天不会太冷的。
s_py: fàng xīn ba míng tiān bù huì tài lěng de
zh: 放心吧，明天不会太冷的。
py: fàng xīn ba míng tiān bù huì tài lěng de
en: Relax, it won't be too cold tomorrow.
why: 不会 ... 的 reassures about what will not happen, with 的 closing the sentence. It is correct.
